ValidationRule.description: Lock end date for a loyalty user if there is an extension variation in place
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $RecordType.DeveloperName = "Loyalty_Commercial", $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "Qantas System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "Qantas System Admin - Freight", $Profile.Name <> "Qantas System Admin - QCC", $Profile.Name <> "Qantas System Admin - SND", Count_of_Extension_Variation_Type__c > 0, ISCHANGED( Contract_End_Date__c ), Lock_system__c =false )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Extension is in place, please do not edit the end date
